newsitem.title: USA: Intl FiberCom to buy tele-equipment company.
newsitem.headline: Intl FiberCom to buy tele-equipment company.

text.p: International FiberCom Inc said Wednesday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets and business of a privately-held telecommunications equipment company located in the southeast United States.
International FiberCom said the acquisition would increase its annual revenue base to about $45 million and would have an immediate and substantial accretive impact on its earnings per share.
Terms of the deal and the identity of the company were not disclosed.
The acquisition is expected to be completed during the fourth quarter of 1997 and closing is contingent upon the execution of a definitive purchase agreement and other items.
The company said the acquisition candidate recorded substantial profits on revenues of about $15 million in 1996 and has recorded profits in each of the nine years of its existence.

International FiberCom said the target company deals in equipment manufactured by Lucent Technologies, Northern Telecom, DSC Communications/Digital Switch, ADC Telecommunications, Tellabs, Alcatel and Fujitsu.
